channel.title: Our Work on Kayte Studio
channel.description: Recent content in Our Work on Kayte Studio

item.title: Kayte Lang
item.description: An experimental language with BASIC-style and JavaScript-like syntaxes that compile to the same bytecode, or to native executables for macOS, Linux, Windows, iOS and WebAssembly.

item.title: Kayte Studio
item.description: KayteIDE, our Qt 6 / C++17 development environment for Kayte, C++, Pascal/Delphi and Visual Basic, with a visual RAD form designer, built-in Git and Subversion, and a unit-test runner.

item.title: OS/2 Emulation
item.description: A bare-metal, OS/2-style operating system in C11 and AArch64 assembly. It runs on QEMU, Raspberry Pi 3+ and BeagleBoard hardware, with an LX .EXE loader, a DOS-style shell, ext4/btrfs and a GUI compositor.
